translations.idiomatic: Astronomy 14

sentences.zh: 客星流隕雲氣

translations.literal: Guest Stars, Meteors and Falls, Clouds and Vapors.
translations.idiomatic: Guest stars; meteors and falls; clouds and vapors

sentences.zh: 客星太祖丁未年九月丙申，彗星見東方。

translations.literal: Guest stars: In Taizu's dingwei year, in the ninth month, on bingshen, a comet appeared in the east.
translations.idiomatic: Guest stars: In Taizu's dingwei year, IX/bingshen, a comet appeared in the east.

sentences.zh: 天命三年十月丙寅，彗星見東方，尾長五丈，每夜漸移向北斗，十九日而沒。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Tianming, in the tenth month, on bingyin, a comet appeared in the east; its tail was five zhang long; each night it shifted gradually toward the Northern Dipper; on the nineteenth day it set.
translations.idiomatic: Tianming 3, X/bingyin: a comet appeared in the east with a five-zhang tail; night by night it drifted toward the Dipper and set on the nineteenth day.

sentences.zh: 順治九年十一月庚寅，異星蒼白氣見於參，西北行入畢。

translations.literal: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, in the eleventh month, on gengyin, an unusual star of pale bluish vapor appeared at Shen, moving northwest into Bi.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 9, XI/gengyin: a pale unusual star appeared at Shen and moved northwest into Bi.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年十月己未朔，有星茀於軫，見東方；

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Kangxi, in the tenth month, on jiwei, the first day of the month, a star flared at Zhen, visible in the east;
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 3, X/jiwei (new moon): a star flared at Zhen and was seen in the east;

sentences.zh: 丁卯，尾長七八寸，蒼色，指西南；

translations.literal: on dingmao, its tail was seven or eight cun long, bluish in color, pointing southwest;
translations.idiomatic: dingmao: tail seven or eight cun, bluish, pointing southwest;

sentences.zh: 丁亥，尾長三尺餘，指西北，逆行至翼；

translations.literal: on dinghai, its tail was a little over three chi long, pointing northwest; it moved retrograde to Yi;
translations.idiomatic: dinghai: tail over three chi, pointing northwest; it retrograded to Yi;

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，尾長五尺餘，指北方，至張；

translations.literal: in the eleventh month, on wuxu, its tail was a little over five chi long, pointing north, reaching Zhang;
translations.idiomatic: XI/wuxu: tail over five chi, pointing north, reaching Zhang;

sentences.zh: 庚子，至井；

translations.literal: on gengzi, it reached Jing;
translations.idiomatic: gengzi: it reached Jing;

sentences.zh: 癸卯，往西北行至昴；

translations.literal: on guimao, it went northwest as far as Mao;
translations.idiomatic: guimao: it traveled northwest to Mao;

sentences.zh: 乙巳，尾指東北，至胃；

translations.literal: on yisi, its tail pointed northeast, reaching Wei;
translations.idiomatic: yisi: tail toward the northeast, reaching Wei;

sentences.zh: 庚戌，至婁，尾指東，青色；

translations.literal: on gengxu, it reached Lou; its tail pointed east; the color was green;
translations.idiomatic: gengxu: it reached Lou; tail eastward; green in color;

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，至奎，體小，尾長二尺餘。

translations.literal: in the twelfth month, on renxu, it reached Kui; the body was small; the tail was a little over two chi long.
translations.idiomatic: XII/renxu: it reached Kui; the nucleus had shrunk; the tail was just over two chi.

sentences.zh: 四年二月己巳，東南方有異星見於女；

translations.literal: In the 4th year, second month, on jisi, an unusual star appeared at Nu in the southeast;
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 4, II/jisi: an unusual star appeared at Nu in the southeast;

sentences.zh: 甲戌，尾長七寸，指西南，蒼白色；

translations.literal: on jiaxu, its tail was seven cun long, pointing southwest, pale bluish-white;
translations.idiomatic: jiaxu: tail seven cun, southwest, pale bluish-white;

sentences.zh: 丁丑，尾長尺餘，往東北順行至虛；

translations.literal: on dingchou, its tail was a little over one chi long; it moved prograde northeast to Xu;
translations.idiomatic: dingchou: tail just over one chi; it ran northeast in prograde motion to Xu;

sentences.zh: 辛巳，至室，體漸大，尾長八尺餘；

translations.literal: on xinsi, it reached Shi; the body gradually grew larger; the tail was a little over eight chi long;
translations.idiomatic: xinsi: it reached Shi; the body swelled; the tail grew to over eight chi;

sentences.zh: 乙酉，至壁，尾長五尺餘。

translations.literal: on yiyou, it reached Bi; the tail was a little over five chi long.
translations.idiomatic: yiyou: it reached Bi with a tail of over five chi.

sentences.zh: 七年正月甲子，西南白光，長六尺餘，尾指東南，占曰天槍；

translations.literal: In the 7th year, first month, on jiazi, a white light in the southwest, more than six chi long; its tail pointed southeast; the omen reads "Celestial Spear";
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 7, I/jiazi: a white beam in the southwest over six chi long, tail toward the southeast—the omen is the Celestial Spear;

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，漸長至四丈餘，尾掃天苑、九斿、軍井；

translations.literal: in the second month, on yihai, it gradually lengthened to a little over four zhang; its tail swept Tianyuan, Jiuyou, and Junjing;
translations.idiomatic: II/yihai: it lengthened to over four zhang, its tail brushing Tianyuan, Jiuyou, and Junjing;

sentences.zh: 丁亥，沒。

translations.literal: on dinghai, it set.
translations.idiomatic: dinghai: it disappeared.

sentences.zh: 十二年二月癸巳，異星見於婁，大如核桃，色白，尾長尺餘，指東方；

translations.literal: In the 12th year, second month, on guisi, an unusual star appeared at Lou, as large as a walnut, white in color, with a tail a little over one chi long, pointing east;
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 12, II/guisi: an unusual star at Lou, walnut-sized and white, with a tail over one chi pointing east;

sentences.zh: 甲午，仍見。

translations.literal: on jiawu, it was still visible.
translations.idiomatic: jiawu: still visible.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月戊子，異星見於天苑東北，色白。

translations.literal: In the 15th year, first month, on wuzi, an unusual star appeared northeast of Tianyuan, white in color.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 15, I/wuzi: a white unusual star appeared northeast of Tianyuan.

sentences.zh: 十六年三月癸卯，東北方有異星見於婁，體色光明潤澤，尾長尺餘，指西南，占曰含譽。

translations.literal: In the 16th year, third month, on guimao, an unusual star appeared at Lou in the northeast; its body was bright, lustrous, and glossy; its tail was a little over one chi long, pointing southwest; the omen reads "Harbor of Praise."
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 16, III/guimao: a bright, lustrous unusual star at Lou in the northeast, tail over one chi toward the southwest—the omen is Harbor of Praise.

sentences.zh: 十九年十月戊子，彗星見右執法，色白，尾長尺餘，指西方，東行甚速；

translations.literal: In the 19th year, tenth month, on wuzi, a comet appeared at Right Law-Enforcer, white in color, with a tail a little over one chi long, pointing west; it moved east very swiftly;
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 19, X/wuzi: a white comet at Right Law-Enforcer, tail over one chi westward, racing east;

sentences.zh: 壬寅，近太陽不見。

translations.literal: on renyin, near the sun, it was not visible.
translations.idiomatic: renyin: too near the sun to be seen.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰朔，尾跡夕見西方；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingchen, the first day of the month, its tail-trail was seen in the west at dusk;
translations.idiomatic: XI/bingchen (new moon): only the tail-trail showed in the west at dusk;

sentences.zh: 壬戌見星體，色蒼白，尾長六丈餘，寬二尺餘，指東北。

translations.literal: On renxu the star itself was seen, pale bluish in color; its tail was a little over six zhang long and a little over two chi wide, pointing northeast.
translations.idiomatic: renxu: the nucleus appeared, pale bluish, with a tail over six zhang long and two chi wide toward the northeast.

sentences.zh: 二十一年七月己巳，彗星見北河之北，色白，尾長二尺餘，指西南，往東北行甚速；

translations.literal: In the 21st year, seventh month, on jisi, a comet appeared north of North River, white in color, with a tail a little over two chi long, pointing southwest; it moved northeast very swiftly;
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 21, VII/jisi: a white comet north of North River, tail over two chi southwestward, hurtling northeast;

sentences.zh: 壬申，入午宮，尾長六尺餘。

translations.literal: on renshen, it entered the Wu palace; its tail was a little over six chi long.
translations.idiomatic: renshen: it entered the Wu palace with a tail of over six chi.

sentences.zh: 二十二年閏六月庚戌，異星見於五車北八穀東，色白，往西南逆行；

translations.literal: In the 22nd year, intercalary sixth month, on gengxu, an unusual star appeared east of Bagu and north of Wuche, white in color, moving retrograde southwest;
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 22, intercalary VI/gengxu: a white unusual star east of Bagu and north of Wuche, retrograding southwest;

sentences.zh: 戊辰，入五車。

translations.literal: on wuchen, it entered Wuche.
translations.idiomatic: wuchen: it entered Wuche.

sentences.zh: 二十三年五月甲申，異星見太微垣，東屬軫，色白明大，往東北順行；

translations.literal: In the 23rd year, fifth month, on jiashen, an unusual star appeared in the Supreme Palace Enclosure, attached on the east to Zhen, white, bright, and large, moving prograde northeast;
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 23, V/jiashen: a large, bright white unusual star in the Supreme Palace Enclosure, linked east to Zhen, running prograde northeast;

sentences.zh: 乙酉，行四度餘，至右攝提下。

translations.literal: on yiyou, it traveled a little over four degrees, reaching below Right Sieve-Handle.
translations.idiomatic: yiyou: after a little over four degrees it stood below Right Sieve-Handle.

sentences.zh: 二十五年七月庚寅，異星見東方，近地平，色白，東行不急；

translations.literal: In the 25th year, seventh month, on gengyin, an unusual star appeared in the east, near the horizon, white in color, moving east without haste;
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 25, VII/gengyin: a white unusual star low in the east, drifting east at an easy pace;

sentences.zh: 丁酉，凡行十六度，至柳，微有尾跡；

translations.literal: on dingyou, having traveled sixteen degrees in all, it reached Liu, with a slight tail-trail;
translations.idiomatic: dingyou: after sixteen degrees it reached Liu with a faint tail-trail;

sentences.zh: 壬寅，至星，漸沒。

translations.literal: on renyin, it reached Xing and gradually set.
translations.idiomatic: renyin: it reached Xing and faded away.

sentences.zh: 二十七年十月己酉，異星見奎，色白，凡三夜。

translations.literal: In the 27th year, tenth month, on jiyou, an unusual star appeared at Kui, white in color, for three nights in all.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 27, X/jiyou: a white unusual star at Kui, visible three nights.

sentences.zh: 二十九年八月己酉，異星見箕，色黃，凡二夜。

translations.literal: In the 29th year, eighth month, on jiyou, an unusual star appeared at Ji, yellow in color, for two nights in all.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 29, VIII/jiyou: a yellow unusual star at Ji, visible two nights.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年九月己丑，異星見弧矢下，色白，體微，芒長尺餘，指西北，逆行至井。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Yongzheng, ninth month, on jichou, an unusual star appeared below Arc and Arrow, white in color, its body slight, with rays a little over one chi long, pointing northwest; it moved retrograde to Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzheng 1, IX/jichou: a faint white unusual star below Arc and Arrow, rays over one chi northwestward, retrograding to Jing.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年六月丁卯，異星出右更東，色白，屬婁，向西南行；

translations.literal: In the 2nd year of Qianlong, sixth month, on dingmao, an unusual star emerged east of Right Geng, white in color, belonging to Lou, moving southwest;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 2, VI/dingmao: a white unusual star east of Right Geng, in Lou, moving southwest;

sentences.zh: 丙子，仍見。

translations.literal: on bingzi, it was still visible.
translations.idiomatic: bingzi: still visible.

sentences.zh: 七年正月丁亥，異星見東南方；

translations.literal: In the 7th year, first month, on dinghai, an unusual star appeared in the southeast;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 7, I/dinghai: an unusual star in the southeast;

sentences.zh: 戊子，出地二十七度餘，大如彈丸，色黃，尾長四尺餘，指西南，屬醜宮，在天市垣徐星外，逆行四旬餘不見。

translations.literal: on wuzi, it had risen twenty-seven-odd degrees above the horizon, as large as a pellet, yellow in color, with a tail a little over four chi long, pointing southwest, belonging to the Chou palace, outside Xu's star in the Celestial Market Enclosure; it moved retrograde for forty-odd days and was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: wuzi: risen twenty-seven-odd degrees, pellet-sized and yellow, tail over four chi southwestward in the Chou palace beyond Xu's star in the Celestial Market; after forty-odd days of retrograde motion it vanished.

sentences.zh: 八年十一月己亥，彗星見奎、壁之間，大如彈丸，色黃白，尾長尺餘，向東指，屬戌宮，逆行至九年正月辛卯，凡五十三日，行二十九度餘。

translations.literal: In the 8th year, eleventh month, on jihai, a comet appeared between Kui and Bi, as large as a pellet, yellow-white in color, with a tail a little over one chi long, pointing east, belonging to the Xu palace; it moved retrograde until the 1st month of the 9th year, on xinmao—fifty-three days in all, traveling twenty-nine-odd degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 8, XI/jihai: a pellet-sized yellow-white comet between Kui and Bi, tail over one chi eastward in the Xu palace; it retrograded until Qianlong 9, I/xinmao—fifty-three days and twenty-nine-odd degrees.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月癸丑，異星見東方，大如榛子，色黃，尾長二尺餘，向西南指，在離宮第三星南，順行至四月甲寅朔，行三度，尾長尺餘，體小光微；

translations.literal: In the 13th year, third month, on guichou, an unusual star appeared in the east, as large as a hazelnut, yellow in color, with a tail a little over two chi long, pointing southwest, south of the third star of Ligong; it moved prograde until the first day of the fourth month, on jiayin—three degrees traveled; its tail was a little over one chi long; the body was small and the light faint;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 13, III/guichou: a hazelnut-sized yellow unusual star in the east, tail over two chi southwestward south of Ligong's third star; by IV/jiayin (new moon) it had run three degrees prograde, tail down to one chi, body small and dim;

sentences.zh: 壬戌，至螣蛇；

translations.literal: on renxu, it reached Tengshe;
translations.idiomatic: renxu: it reached Tengshe;

sentences.zh: 乙丑，至王良；

translations.literal: on yichou, it reached Wangliang;
translations.idiomatic: yichou: it reached Wangliang;

sentences.zh: 丙寅，不見。

translations.literal: on bingyin, it was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: bingyin: no longer visible.

sentences.zh: 十四年五月甲寅，瑞星見東方，大如雞卵，形長圓，色黃白，光瑩潤澤，行不急，出天津，入芻槁，占曰含譽。

translations.literal: In the 14th year, fifth month, on jiayin, an auspicious star appeared in the east, as large as a hen's egg, long and round in shape, yellow-white in color, its light bright, lustrous, and glossy; it moved without haste, emerging from Tianjin and entering Chugao; the omen reads "Harbor of Praise."
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 14, V/jiayin: an auspicious star in the east, egg-sized, oblong, yellow-white and lustrous, moving unhurriedly from Tianjin into Chugao—the omen is Harbor of Praise.

sentences.zh: 二十四年三月壬辰，彗星見東南方；

translations.literal: In the 24th year, third month, on renchen, a comet appeared in the southeast;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 24, III/renchen: a comet in the southeast;

sentences.zh: 甲午，出虛第一星下，大如榛子，色蒼白，尾長尺餘，指西南，順行；

translations.literal: on jiawu, it emerged below the first star of Xu, as large as a hazelnut, pale bluish-white in color, with a tail a little over one chi long, pointing southwest, moving prograde;
translations.idiomatic: jiawu: below Xu's first star, hazelnut-sized and pale, tail over one chi southwestward in prograde motion;

sentences.zh: 癸卯，體小光微，尾餘三四寸；

translations.literal: on guimao, the body was small and the light faint; the tail's remainder was three or four cun;
translations.idiomatic: guimao: nucleus shrunk and dim; only three or four cun of tail left;

sentences.zh: 戊申，全消。

translations.literal: on wushen, it vanished entirely.
translations.idiomatic: wushen: gone altogether.

sentences.zh: 四月戊辰，彗星見西南方，在張第二星上；

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on wuchen, a comet appeared in the southwest, above the second star of Zhang;
translations.idiomatic: IV/wuchen: a comet in the southwest above Zhang's second star;

sentences.zh: 己巳，離張六度，大如榛子，色蒼黃，尾光散漫，長二尺餘，指東南，順行；

translations.literal: on jisi, six degrees from Zhang, as large as a hazelnut, grayish-yellow in color, its tail-light diffuse, a little over two chi long, pointing southeast, moving prograde;
translations.idiomatic: jisi: six degrees from Zhang, hazelnut-sized and gray-yellow, tail-light diffuse over two chi southeastward in prograde motion;

sentences.zh: 壬申，形跡微小；

translations.literal: on renshen, its form and track were minute;
translations.idiomatic: renshen: trace barely perceptible;

sentences.zh: 丁丑，更微；

translations.literal: on dingchou, still fainter;
translations.idiomatic: dingchou: fainter still;

sentences.zh: 己卯，漸散；

translations.literal: on jimao, it gradually dispersed;
translations.idiomatic: jimao: dispersing;

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，全消。

translations.literal: in the fifth month, on renwu, it vanished entirely.
translations.idiomatic: V/renwu: gone altogether.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊辰，異星見東南方，在井第四星下，大如榛子，色蒼黃，向西北行；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuchen, an unusual star appeared in the southeast, below the fourth star of Jing, as large as a hazelnut, grayish-yellow in color, moving northwest;
translations.idiomatic: XI/wuchen: a hazelnut-sized gray-yellow unusual star in the southeast below Jing's fourth star, moving northwest;

sentences.zh: 癸酉，行四度，在胃，微有尾跡；

translations.literal: on guiyou, it had traveled four degrees, at Wei, with a slight tail-trail;
translations.idiomatic: guiyou: four degrees on, at Wei with a faint tail-trail;

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑朔，全消。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingchou, the first day of the month, it vanished entirely.
translations.idiomatic: XII/dingchou (new moon): gone altogether.

sentences.zh: 三十四年七月甲辰，彗星見東南方，在昴下；

translations.literal: In the 34th year, seventh month, on jiachen, a comet appeared in the southeast, below Mao;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 34, VII/jiachen: a comet in the southeast below Mao;

sentences.zh: 丁未，大如彈丸，色蒼白，尾長三尺，指西南，順行甚速；

translations.literal: on dingwei, as large as a pellet, pale bluish-white in color, with a tail three chi long, pointing southwest, moving prograde very swiftly;
translations.idiomatic: dingwei: pellet-sized and pale, three-chi tail southwestward, racing in prograde motion;

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，與太陽同宮不見；

translations.literal: in the eighth month, on dingmao, in the same palace as the sun, it was not seen;
translations.idiomatic: VIII/dingmao: in conjunction with the sun and invisible;

sentences.zh: 十月辛亥，見西方，在列肆第二星下，體勢微小，尾長一尺；

translations.literal: in the tenth month, on xinhai, it was seen in the west, below the second star of Liesi; its body was minute; its tail was one chi long;
translations.idiomatic: X/xinhai: visible in the west below Liesi's second star, tiny in body with a one-chi tail;

sentences.zh: 丙子，全消。

translations.literal: on bingzi, it vanished entirely.
translations.idiomatic: bingzi: gone altogether.

sentences.zh: 三十五年閏五月己酉，異星見東南方，在天弁第一星西，大如彈丸，色蒼黃；

translations.literal: In the 35th year, intercalary fifth month, on jiyou, an unusual star appeared in the southeast, west of the first star of Tianbian, as large as a pellet, grayish-yellow in color;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 35, intercalary V/jiyou: a pellet-sized gray-yellow unusual star in the southeast west of Tianbian's first star;

sentences.zh: 癸丑，向北行三十二度；

translations.literal: on guichou, it moved north thirty-two degrees;
translations.idiomatic: guichou: thirty-two degrees northward;

sentences.zh: 乙丑，不見。

translations.literal: on yichou, it was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: yichou: no longer visible.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，彗星見東南方，長尺餘；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yichou, a comet appeared in the southeast, a little over one chi long;
translations.idiomatic: XI/yichou: a comet in the southeast over one chi long;

sentences.zh: 丙寅，在柳第二星下；

translations.literal: on bingyin, it was below the second star of Liu;
translations.idiomatic: bingyin: below Liu's second star;

sentences.zh: 戊辰，色蒼白，尾指東南，每日向西北行十餘度；

translations.literal: on wuchen, pale bluish-white in color; its tail pointed southeast; each day it moved northwest more than ten degrees;
translations.idiomatic: wuchen: pale, tail southeastward, shifting northwest more than ten degrees a day;

sentences.zh: 庚午，微暗；

translations.literal: on gengwu, faint and dim;
translations.idiomatic: gengwu: dimming;

sentences.zh: 辛未，全消。

translations.literal: on xinwei, it vanished entirely.
translations.idiomatic: xinwei: gone altogether.

sentences.zh: 流隕隕星如鬥者，太祖戊子年九月辛亥朔夜，時征王甲城，士馬皆驚。

translations.literal: Meteors and falls: A falling star like a dipper: In Taizu's wuzi year, ninth month, on xinhai, the first night of the month, at the time of the campaign against Wang Jiacheng, soldiers and horses were all alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: Meteors and falls: Dipper-sized meteor: Taizu wuzi year, IX/xinhai (new moon) night, during the assault on Wang Jiacheng; troops and horses were thrown into alarm.

sentences.zh: 流星如盆者，乾隆十四年九月壬申，出婁宿，色赤，入天苑，有光，有尾跡。

translations.literal: A shooting star like a basin: In the 14th year of Qianlong, ninth month, on renshen, it emerged from the lodge of Lou, red in color, entering Tianyuan, with light and a tail-trail.
translations.idiomatic: Basin-sized meteor: Qianlong 14, IX/renshen, from the lodge of Lou, red, into Tianyuan, bright with a tail-trail.

sentences.zh: 流星如碗者，順治四年十一月庚辰，自天中西北行入蜀，有聲，色赤，光燭地，雞犬皆驚。

translations.literal: A shooting star like a bowl: In the 4th year of Shunzhi, eleventh month, on gengchen, from mid-heaven it moved northwest into Shu, with sound, red in color, its light illuminating the ground; chickens and dogs were all alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: Bowl-sized meteor: Shunzhi 4, XI/gengchen, from mid-heaven northwest into Shu, roaring, red, light flooding the ground; fowl and dogs panicked.

sentences.zh: 五年九月辛巳如之，聲如雷。

translations.literal: In the 5th year, ninth month, on xinsi, the same; the sound was like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 5, IX/xinsi: the same, with thunderous sound.

sentences.zh: 十五年六月辛未，自西北至東南，有聲，色赤，不著光、尾跡。

translations.literal: In the 15th year, sixth month, on xinwei, from northwest to southeast, with sound, red in color, without noticeable light or tail-trail.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 15, VI/xinwei: northwest to southeast, audible, red, without bright light or tail-trail.

sentences.zh: 流星如盞者，順治四年五月戊午寅時，自西北至西南，色青白，有光。

translations.literal: A shooting star like a cup: In the 4th year of Shunzhi, fifth month, on wuwu, at the yin hour, from northwest to southwest, greenish-white in color, with light.
translations.idiomatic: Cup-sized meteor: Shunzhi 4, V/wuwu, yin hour, northwest to southwest, greenish-white and luminous.

sentences.zh: 七年八月甲午，自東南至東北，色赤黃，入鬥，不著光、尾跡。

translations.literal: In the 7th year, eighth month, on jiawu, from southeast to northeast, red-yellow in color, entering Dou, without noticeable light or tail-trail.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 7, VIII/jiawu: southeast to northeast, red-yellow into Dou, without bright light or tail-trail.

sentences.zh: 八年四月己酉，自氐宿南行，色青白；

translations.literal: In the 8th year, fourth month, on jiyou, from the lodge of Di it moved south, greenish-white in color;
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 8, IV/jiyou: from the lodge of Di southward, greenish-white;

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，自亢宿西南行，色白，眾小星隨之，入翼；

translations.literal: in the fifth month, on wuyin, from the lodge of Kang it moved southwest, white in color; many small stars followed it, entering Yi;
translations.idiomatic: V/wuyin: from Kang southwest, white, many small stars following into Yi;

sentences.zh: 九年三月丙子，自中天西南行，色赤，入畢；

translations.literal: in the 9th year, third month, on bingzi, from mid-heaven it moved southwest, red in color, entering Bi;
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 9, III/bingzi: from mid-heaven southwest, red, into Bi;

sentences.zh: 俱有光，有尾跡。

translations.literal: all with light and tail-trails.
translations.idiomatic: all bright with tail-trails.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，自中天入紫微垣，色赤；

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingshen, from mid-heaven it entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, red in color;
translations.idiomatic: IX/bingshen: from mid-heaven into the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, red;

sentences.zh: 十年八月丙寅，自中天入天市垣，色青赤；

translations.literal: in the 10th year, eighth month, on bingyin, from mid-heaven it entered the Celestial Market Enclosure, greenish-red in color;
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 10, VIII/bingyin: from mid-heaven into the Celestial Market Enclosure, greenish-red;

sentences.zh: 俱有光。

translations.literal: both with light.
translations.idiomatic: both luminous.

sentences.zh: 十二年四月甲子，自亢宿入危，色赤黃，有光，有尾跡。

translations.literal: In the 12th year, fourth month, on jiazi, from the lodge of Kang it entered Wei, red-yellow in color, with light and a tail-trail.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 12, IV/jiazi: from Kang into Wei, red-yellow, bright with a tail-trail.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，出房宿，色青黃，入尾；

translations.literal: on guiyou, it emerged from the lodge of Fang, greenish-yellow in color, entering Wei (Tail);
translations.idiomatic: guiyou: from Fang, greenish-yellow into Tail;

sentences.zh: 十六年七月甲申，出牛宿，東北行，色赤黃，至蜀沒；

translations.literal: in the 16th year, seventh month, on jiashen, it emerged from the lodge of Niu, moving northeast, red-yellow in color, setting in Shu;
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 16, VII/jiashen: from Niu northeast, red-yellow, setting in Shu;

sentences.zh: 俱不著光跡。

translations.literal: both without noticeable light-trails.
translations.idiomatic: both without bright light or trails.

sentences.zh: 康熙二年八月丁巳，自虛宿入紫微垣，小星隨之；

translations.literal: In the 2nd year of Kangxi, eighth month, on dingsi, from the lodge of Xu it entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, small stars following it;
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 2, VIII/dingsi: from Xu into the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, small stars in its train;

sentences.zh: 三年九月戊申，自中天入奎；

translations.literal: in the 3rd year, ninth month, on wushen, from mid-heaven it entered Kui;
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 3, IX/wushen: from mid-heaven into Kui;

sentences.zh: 俱色赤；

translations.literal: both red in color;
translations.idiomatic: both red;

sentences.zh: 六年正月戊寅，出鬼宿，色青，隨後有聲，入土司空；

translations.literal: In the 6th year, first month, on wuyin, it emerged from the lodge of Ghost, green in color, with sound following behind, entering Earth Granary;
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 6, I/wuyin: from Ghost, green, with sound trailing behind, into Earth Granary;

sentences.zh: 七年二月戊子，出大角，色赤黃，入箕；

translations.literal: in the 7th year, second month, on wuzi, it emerged from Great Horn, red-yellow in color, entering Winnowing Basket;
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 7, II/wuzi: from Great Horn, red-yellow, into Winnowing Basket;

sentences.zh: 十二年九月甲午，出勾陳，色青白，至蜀沒；

translations.literal: in the 12th year, ninth month, on jiawu, it emerged from Gouchen, greenish-white in color, setting in Shu;
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 12, IX/jiawu: from Gouchen, greenish-white, setting in Shu;

sentences.zh: 俱有光、有尾跡。

translations.literal: all with light and tail-trails.
translations.idiomatic: all bright with tail-trails.

sentences.zh: 十六年九月己亥酉時，自正北下行，色赤白，尾跡如蛇，有光。

translations.literal: In the 16th year, ninth month, on jihai, at the you hour, from due north it descended, red-white in color, its tail-trail like a serpent, with light.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 16, IX/jihai, you hour: from due north downward, red-white, tail-trail serpentine, luminous.

sentences.zh: 十九年六月癸酉酉時，自西南向東北，聲如雷，尾跡如匹布。

translations.literal: In the 19th year, sixth month, on guiyou, at the you hour, from southwest toward northeast, the sound like thunder, its tail-trail like a bolt of cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 19, VI/guiyou, you hour: southwest to northeast, thunderous, tail-trail like a bolt of cloth.

sentences.zh: 二十五年十一月壬午，出左樞，色白，至蜀沒，尾長竟天。

translations.literal: In the 25th year, eleventh month, on renwu, it emerged from Left Pivot, white in color, setting in Shu; its tail extended across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 25, XI/renwu: from Left Pivot, white, setting in Shu, tail spanning heaven.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，出軫宿，色青黃，入騎官。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuyin, it emerged from the lodge of Chariot, greenish-yellow in color, entering Cavalry Officer.
translations.idiomatic: XII/wuyin: from Chariot, greenish-yellow, into Cavalry Officer.

sentences.zh: 二十九年二月丁亥，出河鼓，色黃，入尾。

translations.literal: In the 29th year, second month, on dinghai, it emerged from River Drum, yellow in color, entering Tail.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 29, II/dinghai: from River Drum, yellow, into Tail.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十九年正月丁巳一更，出奎宿，西北行；

translations.literal: In the 19th year of Qianlong, first month, on dingsi, at the first watch, it emerged from the lodge of Kui, moving northwest;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 19, I/dingsi, first watch: from Kui, northwest;

sentences.zh: 二十二年三月戊申一更，出西北方，下行；

translations.literal: in the 22nd year, third month, on wushen, at the first watch, it emerged from the northwest, descending;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 22, III/wushen, first watch: from the northwest, downward;

sentences.zh: 俱色青。

translations.literal: both green in color.
translations.idiomatic: both green.

sentences.zh: 二十四年閏六月甲申五更，出土司空，下行；

translations.literal: In the 24th year, intercalary sixth month, on jiashen, at the fifth watch, it emerged from Earth Granary, descending;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 24, intercalary VI/jiashen, fifth watch: from Earth Granary, downward;

sentences.zh: 三十五年九月戊辰三更，出室宿，西北行；

translations.literal: in the 35th year, ninth month, on wuchen, at the third watch, it emerged from the lodge of Room, moving northwest;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 35, IX/wuchen, third watch: from Room, northwest;

sentences.zh: 俱色赤，俱入雲。

translations.literal: both red in color, both entering clouds.
translations.idiomatic: both red, both entered clouds.

sentences.zh: 三十六年二月己丑昏，出上弼，下行，色黃，不著入。

translations.literal: In the 36th year, second month, on jichou, at dusk, it emerged from Upper Assistant, descending, yellow in color, without noticeable ingress.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 36, II/jichou, dusk: from Upper Assistant, downward, yellow, without visibly entering [a lodge].

sentences.zh: 三十九年十月丙戌二更，出天廩，西行；

translations.literal: In the 39th year, tenth month, on bingxu, at the second watch, it emerged from Celestial Granary, moving west;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 39, X/bingxu, second watch: from Celestial Granary, west;

sentences.zh: 四十年九月丁未一更，出壘壁陣西，下行；

translations.literal: In the 40th year, ninth month, on dingwei, at the first watch, it emerged west of Wall Ramparts, descending;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 40, IX/dingwei, first watch: west of Wall Ramparts, downward;

sentences.zh: 四十一年三月丁丑昏，出翼宿，西南行；

translations.literal: In the 41st year, third month, on dingchou, at dusk, it emerged from the lodge of Wings, moving southwest;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 41, III/dingchou, dusk: from Wings, southwest;

sentences.zh: 十月丁卯曉，出平道，下行，俱色赤。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on dingmao, at dawn, it emerged from Flat Road, descending; all red in color.
translations.idiomatic: X/dingmao, dawn: from Flat Road, downward; both red.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，出天苑，下行；

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guichou, it emerged from Heavenly Park, descending;
translations.idiomatic: XII/guichou: from Heavenly Park, downward;

sentences.zh: 四十二年八月壬戌一更，出右旗，西行；

translations.literal: In the 42nd year, eighth month, on renxu, at the first watch, it emerged from Right Banner, moving west;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 42, VIII/renxu, first watch: from Right Banner, west;

sentences.zh: 俱色白。

translations.literal: both white in color.
translations.idiomatic: both white.

sentences.zh: 五十四年十二月己卯昏，出參宿，下行；

translations.literal: In the 54th year, twelfth month, on jimao, at dusk, it emerged from the lodge of Shen, descending;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 54, XII/jimao, dusk: from Shen, downward;

sentences.zh: 五十五年九月壬寅一更，出五車，西行；

translations.literal: In the 55th year, ninth month, on renyin, at the first watch, it emerged from Five Chariots, moving west;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 55, IX/renyin, first watch: from Five Chariots, west;

sentences.zh: 五十六年三月庚寅五更，出天津，下行；

translations.literal: In the 56th year, third month, on gengyin, at the fifth watch, it emerged from Tianjin, descending;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 56, III/gengyin, fifth watch: from Tianjin, downward;

sentences.zh: 五十七年五月丙辰一更，出天棓，東北行；

translations.literal: In the 57th year, fifth month, on bingchen, at the first watch, it emerged from Celestial Flail, moving northeast;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 57, V/bingchen, first watch: from Celestial Flail, northeast;

sentences.zh: 五十八年九月己亥五更，出婁宿，西南行。

translations.literal: In the 58th year, ninth month, on jihai, at the fifth watch, it emerged from the lodge of Lou, moving southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 58, IX/jihai, fifth watch: from Lou, southwest.

sentences.zh: 五十九年十月丙寅曉，出張宿，下行；

translations.literal: In the 59th year, tenth month, on bingyin, at dawn, it emerged from the lodge of Zhang, descending;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 59, X/bingyin, dawn: from Zhang, downward;

sentences.zh: 六十年閏二月戊戌三更，出大角，西北行；

translations.literal: In the 60th year, intercalary second month, on wuxu, at the third watch, it emerged from Great Horn, moving northwest;
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 60, intercalary II/wuxu, third watch: from Great Horn, northwest;

sentences.zh: 俱色赤，俱入雲，俱有光、有尾跡。

translations.literal: all red in color, all entering clouds, all with light and tail-trails.
translations.idiomatic: all red, all entered clouds, all bright with tail-trails.

sentences.zh: 流星如飲鍾者，康熙八年九月乙卯巳時，出午位，色赤黃，入巳位，不著光、尾跡。

translations.literal: A shooting star like a wine vessel: In the 8th year of Kangxi, ninth month, on yimao, at the si hour, it emerged from the Wu position, red-yellow in color, entering the Si position, without noticeable light or tail-trail.
translations.idiomatic: Wine-vessel-sized meteor: Kangxi 8, IX/yimao, si hour, from the Wu position, red-yellow, into the Si position, without noticeable light or tail-trail.

sentences.zh: 流星如杯者，乾隆十八年七月甲戌三更，出奎宿，東南行，色赤，入雲，有光，有尾跡。

translations.literal: A shooting star like a cup: In the 18th year of Qianlong, seventh month, on jiaxu, at the third watch, it emerged from the lodge of Kui, moving southeast, red in color, entering clouds, with light and a tail-trail.
translations.idiomatic: Cup-sized meteor: Qianlong 18, VII/jiaxu, third watch, from Kui, southeast, red, entered clouds, bright with a tail-trail.

sentences.zh: 流星如桃者，順治五年八月癸巳朔，自中天東北行，不著色，入天關。

translations.literal: A shooting star like a peach: In the 5th year of Shunzhi, eighth month, on guisi, the first day of the month, from mid-heaven it moved northeast, without noticeable color, entering Celestial Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Peach-sized meteor: Shunzhi 5, VIII/guisi (new moon), from mid-heaven northeast, without noticeable color, into Celestial Gate.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月癸卯，自奎宿入天中，色黃白，俱有光、有尾跡。

translations.literal: In the 13th year, first month, on guimao, from the lodge of Kui it entered mid-heaven, yellow-white in color; both with light and tail-trails.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 13, I/guimao: from Kui into mid-heaven, yellow-white; both bright with tail-trails.

sentences.zh: 康熙二年八月乙巳，自中天至心，不著色、光、尾跡。

translations.literal: In the 2nd year of Kangxi, eighth month, on yisi, from mid-heaven to Heart, without noticeable color, light, or tail-trail.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 2, VIII/yisi: from mid-heaven to Heart, without noticeable color, light, or tail-trail.

sentences.zh: 四年六月壬申，出建星，入南斗；

translations.literal: In the 4th year, sixth month, on renshen, it emerged from Jianxing, entering Southern Dipper;
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 4, VI/renshen: from Jianxing into Southern Dipper;

sentences.zh: 辛巳，出天棓，入河鼓；

translations.literal: on xinsi, it emerged from Celestial Flail, entering River Drum;
translations.idiomatic: xinsi: from Celestial Flail into River Drum;

sentences.zh: 又出閣道，入離宮，俱色赤。

translations.literal: again it emerged from Gallery, entering Lateral Palace; all red in color.
translations.idiomatic: again from Gallery into Lateral Palace; all red.

sentences.zh: 壬午，出庶子，入開陽，色赤黃。

translations.literal: On renwu, it emerged from Commoner, entering Bright Opening, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: renwu: from Commoner into Bright Opening, red-yellow.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申朔，出女宿，入羽林軍，小星隨之，不著色。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiashen, the first day of the month, it emerged from the lodge of Woman, entering Feathered Forest Army; small stars followed it, without noticeable color.
translations.idiomatic: IX/jiashen (new moon): from Woman into Feathered Forest Army, small stars in its train, without noticeable color.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，出南河，入柳，小星隨之；

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renshen, it emerged from South River, entering Willow; small stars followed it;
translations.idiomatic: XII/renshen: from South River into Willow, small stars in its train;

sentences.zh: 五年正月己酉，出參旗，入天苑，俱色青白。

translations.literal: In the 5th year, first month, on jiyou, it emerged from Shen Banner, entering Heavenly Park; all greenish-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 5, I/jiyou: from Shen Banner into Heavenly Park; both greenish-white.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，出五車，至蜀沒；

translations.literal: In the second month, on wuwu, it emerged from Five Chariots, setting in Shu;
translations.idiomatic: II/wuwu: from Five Chariots, setting in Shu;

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，出勾陳，入大陵，俱色赤；

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yiyou, it emerged from Gouchen, entering Great Tomb; both red in color;
translations.idiomatic: V/yiyou: from Gouchen into Great Tomb; both red;

sentences.zh: 十月戊午，出少宰，入天棓，色黃；

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on wuwu, it emerged from Junior Minister, entering Celestial Flail, yellow in color;
translations.idiomatic: X/wuwu: from Junior Minister into Celestial Flail, yellow;

sentences.zh: 俱有光、有尾跡。

translations.literal: all with light and tail-trails.
translations.idiomatic: all bright with tail-trails.

sentences.zh: 六年二月庚戌，出氐宿，入大角，色黃，有尾跡。

translations.literal: In the 6th year, second month, on gengxu, it emerged from the lodge of Di, entering Great Horn, yellow in color, with a tail-trail.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 6, II/gengxu: from Di into Great Horn, yellow, with a tail-trail.

sentences.zh: 八年四月癸亥，出天弁，入氐，色青白，有光，尾跡先直後曲，留東，鹹結為雲氣，如魚形，向東散。

translations.literal: In the 8th year, fourth month, on guihai, it emerged from Celestial Cap, entering Di, greenish-white in color, with light; its tail-trail first straight then curved, lingering to the east; all coalesced into cloud-vapor shaped like a fish, scattering eastward.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 8, IV/guihai: from Celestial Cap into Di, greenish-white and luminous; tail-trail first straight then curved, pausing to the east—all coalescing into fish-shaped cloud-vapor scattering eastward.

sentences.zh: 十年正月己未，出勾陳，入華蓋，色黃白，有光。

translations.literal: In the 10th year, first month, on jiwei, it emerged from Gouchen, entering Canopy, yellow-white in color, with light.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 10, I/jiwei: from Gouchen into Canopy, yellow-white and luminous.

sentences.zh: 十一年七月辛未，出東井，入畢，色青黃，有光，有尾跡。

translations.literal: In the 11th year, seventh month, on xinwei, it emerged from Eastern Well, entering Net, greenish-yellow in color, with light and a tail-trail.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 11, VII/xinwei: from Eastern Well into Net, greenish-yellow, bright with a tail-trail.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月甲申辰時，自西北至西南，色白，有光。

translations.literal: In the 13th year, third month, on jiashen, at the chen hour, from northwest to southwest, white in color, with light.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 13, III/jiashen, chen hour: northwest to southwest, white and luminous.

sentences.zh: 十五年九月丁未，出外屏，入墳墓，色青黃，有光，有尾跡。

translations.literal: In the 15th year, ninth month, on dingwei, it emerged from Outer Screen, entering Tomb, greenish-yellow in color, with light and a tail-trail.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 15, IX/dingwei: from Outer Screen into Tomb, greenish-yellow, bright with a tail-trail.

sentences.zh: 十六年四月丁未朔，出紫微垣，在雲中，往北行，不著色，映地有光。

translations.literal: In the 16th year, fourth month, on dingwei, the first day of the month, it emerged from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, amid clouds, moving northward, without noticeable color; its light reflected on the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 16, IV/dingwei (new moon): from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, in clouds, northward, without noticeable color, light cast on the ground.

sentences.zh: 十七年九月辛丑，出昴宿，入閣道，色青白，有光，有尾跡。

translations.literal: In the 17th year, ninth month, on xinchou, it emerged from the lodge of Mao, entering Gallery, greenish-white in color, with light and a tail-trail.

sentences.zh: 七月癸卯戌初初刻，出東北，高五十餘度，下行至二十餘度沒，色白，有光，有尾跡，皆以晝見。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on guimao, at the start of the xu hour, first quarter, it emerged from the northeast, over fifty degrees high, descending to over twenty degrees before setting, white in color, with light and a tail-trail; all seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: VII/guimao, start of xu first quarter: from the northeast, over fifty degrees high, descending to over twenty degrees before setting, white, luminous with a tail-trail; all seen by day.

sentences.zh: 其餘順治年間五，康熙年間六十二，雍正年間一十三，乾隆年間三千一百有餘，皆以昏、曉及夜見。

translations.literal: The rest: five during the Shunzhi reign, sixty-two during the Kangxi reign, thirteen during the Yongzheng reign, and over 3,100 during the Qianlong reign—all were seen at dusk, dawn, and night.
translations.idiomatic: The rest: five in Shunzhi, sixty-two in Kangxi, thirteen in Yongzheng, over 3,100 in Qianlong—all seen at dusk, dawn, and night.

sentences.zh: 流星如榛子者，乾隆年間一十四，皆以夜見。

translations.literal: Shooting stars like hazelnuts: fourteen during the Qianlong reign, all seen at night.
translations.idiomatic: Hazelnut-sized meteors: fourteen during the Qianlong reign, all seen at night.

sentences.zh: 雲氣太祖壬子年九月癸丑，東方有藍、白二氣。

translations.literal: Clouds and Vapors: In Taizu's renzi year, ninth month, on guichou, in the east there were two vapors, blue and white.
translations.idiomatic: Clouds and vapors: Taizu renzi year, IX/guichou—blue and white vapors in the east.

sentences.zh: 癸丑年九月庚辰，日傍有青、紅二氣，對照如門，祥光四英。

translations.literal: In guichou year, ninth month, on gengchen, beside the sun were two vapors, green and red, facing each other like a gate; auspicious light radiating in four directions.
translations.idiomatic: Guichou year, IX/gengchen: green and red vapors beside the sun, facing like a gate; auspicious light in four directions.

sentences.zh: 乙卯年三月甲戌，有黃氣亙天，人麵英之皆黃。

translations.literal: In yimao year, third month, on jiaxu, yellow vapor spanned heaven; when people faced the radiance, all appeared yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Yimao year, III/jiaxu: yellow vapor spanning heaven; faces turned toward the radiance all appeared yellow.

sentences.zh: 十月戊申，有紅、綠祥光二道夾日，又有藍白光一道，掩英日上如門。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on wushen, two auspicious beams, red and green, flanked the sun; there was also one blue-white beam covering the sun's radiance above like a gate.
translations.idiomatic: X/wushen: red and green auspicious beams flanking the sun, plus a blue-white beam veiling the sun's radiance above like a gate.

sentences.zh: 天命三年正月丙子，有黃氣貫月中，其光寬二尺許，約長三四丈。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Tianming, first month, on bingzi, yellow vapor pierced through the moon; its light was about two chi wide, roughly three or four zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Tianming 3, I/bingzi: yellow vapor through the moon, light about two chi wide and three or four zhang long.

sentences.zh: 四月壬子，有藍、黑氣二道，自西而東，橫亙於天。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on renzi, there were two vapors, blue and black, from west to east, spanning the sky horizontally.
translations.idiomatic: IV/renzi: blue and black vapors from west to east, spanning the sky.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯，有紅、綠、白三氣，自天下垂，覆營左右，上圓如門。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yimao, there were three vapors, red, green, and white, hanging from heaven, covering left and right of the camp, rounded at the top like a gate.
translations.idiomatic: V/yimao: red, green, and white vapors hanging from heaven, covering the camp left and right, arched at top like a gate.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，東南有白氣，自地衝天，末偏銳如刀，約長十五丈，凡十六日而滅。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiayin, in the southeast there was white vapor rushing from earth to heaven; its tip was sharply pointed like a knife, roughly fifteen zhang long; after sixteen days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: IX/jiayin: white vapor in the southeast from earth to heaven, tip knife-sharp, about fifteen zhang long; gone after sixteen days.

sentences.zh: 五年三月癸丑夜，有藍、白二氣，自西向東，繞月之北，至南而止。

translations.literal: In the 5th year, third month, on guichou, at night, there were two vapors, blue and white, from west to east, circling north of the moon and stopping at the south.
translations.idiomatic: Year 5, III/guichou, night: blue and white vapors west to east, circling north of the moon to the south.

sentences.zh: 天聰五年八月丁卯，明兵來攻阿濟格貝勒，大霧不見人，忽有青藍氣自天衝入敵營，霧忽中開如門，我兵遂克。

translations.literal: In the 5th year of Tiancong, eighth month, on dingmao, Ming troops came to attack Prince Ajige; dense fog hid all from sight; suddenly bluish-green vapor rushed from heaven into the enemy camp; the fog parted in the middle like a gate, and our troops prevailed.
translations.idiomatic: Tiancong 5, VIII/dingmao: Ming troops attacked Prince Ajige in dense fog; bluish-green vapor rushed from heaven into the enemy camp, the fog parting like a gate—our troops prevailed.

sentences.zh: 崇德六年九月辛巳黎明，東方有金光大如鬥，內復有金光一道直如椽，衝天而起。

translations.literal: In the 6th year of Chongde, ninth month, on xinsi, at dawn, in the east there was golden light as large as a dipper; within it another golden beam, straight as a rafter, shot skyward.
translations.idiomatic: Chongde 6, IX/xinsi, dawn: golden light in the east dipper-sized; within it a rafter-straight golden beam shooting skyward.

sentences.zh: 順治元年六月庚午酉時，有白氣自西南至東北。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Shunzhi, sixth month, on gengwu, at the you hour, white vapor ran from southwest to northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 1, VI/gengwu, you hour: white vapor southwest to northeast.

sentences.zh: 十月壬辰，五色雲見日上。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on renchen, five-colored clouds appeared above the sun.
translations.idiomatic: X/renchen: five-colored clouds above the sun.

sentences.zh: 三年正月壬戌，北方雲中有赤光如火影。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year, first month, on renxu, in northern clouds there was red light like fire-shadows.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 3, I/renxu: red light like fire-shadows in northern clouds.

sentences.zh: 四年五月庚戌，有白氣自西南至東北。

translations.literal: In the 4th year, fifth month, on gengxu, white vapor ran from southwest to northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 4, V/gengxu: white vapor southwest to northeast.

sentences.zh: 十月壬辰，五色雲見日上。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on renchen, five-colored clouds appeared above the sun.
translations.idiomatic: X/renchen: five-colored clouds above the sun.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰如之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renchen, the same.
translations.idiomatic: XII/renchen: the same.

sentences.zh: 八年十二月壬子夜，有白氣從艮至乾。

translations.literal: In the 8th year, twelfth month, on renzi, at night, white vapor ran from Gen to Qian.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 8, XII/renzi, night: white vapor from Gen to Qian.

sentences.zh: 十年六月丙申，青赤氣生日上下。

translations.literal: In the 10th year, sixth month, on bingshen, greenish-red vapor arose above and below the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 10, VI/bingshen: greenish-red vapor above and below the sun.

sentences.zh: 十二年六月庚午，北方有青黑雲氣，變幻如龍。

translations.literal: In the 12th year, sixth month, on gengwu, in the north there was green-black cloud-vapor shifting form like a dragon.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 12, VI/gengwu: green-black cloud-vapor in the north, shifting like a dragon.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年十二月甲戌，金星生白氣一道，長三丈餘。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Kangxi, twelfth month, on jiaxu, Venus produced one white vapor, a little over three zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 3, XII/jiaxu: Venus produced white vapor over three zhang long.

sentences.zh: 五年二月庚申亥時，中天蒼白氣四五道。

translations.literal: In the 5th year, second month, on gengshen, at the hai hour, four or five grayish-white vapors at mid-heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 5, II/gengshen, hai hour: four or five grayish-white vapors at mid-heaven.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅酉時，東南黑氣一道。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengyin, at the you hour, one black vapor in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: III/gengyin, you hour: one black vapor in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 六年八月己亥，有白光一道，自東至西。

translations.literal: In the 6th year, eighth month, on jihai, one white beam ran from east to west.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 6, VIII/jihai: one white beam east to west.

sentences.zh: 七年正月甲子酉時，西南白光一道，尾至東南入地，約長六尺餘，十餘日漸長至四丈餘，掃天苑、天斿、軍井。

translations.literal: In the 7th year, first month, on jiazi, at the you hour, one white beam in the southwest; its tail reached the southeast and entered the earth, roughly six chi long; over ten days it gradually lengthened to over four zhang, sweeping Tianyuan, Jiuyou, and Junjing.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 7, I/jiazi, you hour: white beam southwest, tail to southeast into earth, about six chi long; over ten days it grew to over four zhang, sweeping Tianyuan, Jiuyou, and Junjing.

sentences.zh: 八年六月甲申，西北直氣一道。

translations.literal: In the 8th year, sixth month, on jiashen, one straight vapor in the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 8, VI/jiashen: one straight vapor in the northwest.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月甲午，五色雲見中天，曆巳至申。

translations.literal: In the 11th year, second month, on jiawu, five-colored clouds appeared at mid-heaven, lasting from the si hour to the shen hour.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 11, II/jiawu: five-colored clouds at mid-heaven from si to shen hours.

sentences.zh: 乙未如之。

translations.literal: On yiwei, the same.
translations.idiomatic: yiwei: the same.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，五色雲見日上。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuzi, five-colored clouds appeared above the sun.
translations.idiomatic: VI/wuzi: five-colored clouds above the sun.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，五色雲見日旁。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guimao, five-colored clouds appeared beside the sun.
translations.idiomatic: XII/guimao: five-colored clouds beside the sun.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月庚辰，西北至東南，蒼白氣經天如匹布。

translations.literal: In the 12th year, first month, on gengchen, from northwest to southeast, grayish-white vapor crossed heaven like a bolt of cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 12, I/gengchen: northwest to southeast, grayish-white vapor spanning heaven like a bolt of cloth.

sentences.zh: 十三年六月己巳夜，東北蒼白雲一道。

translations.literal: In the 13th year, sixth month, on jisi, at night, one grayish-white cloud in the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 13, VI/jisi, night: one grayish-white cloud in the northeast.

sentences.zh: 七月甲戌，白氣一道貫日，自南至北，長六丈餘。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on jiaxu, one white vapor pierced the sun, from south to north, over six zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: VII/jiaxu: white vapor piercing the sun south to north, over six zhang long.

sentences.zh: 十五年三月乙酉，五色雲見中天。

translations.literal: In the 15th year, third month, on yiyou, five-colored clouds appeared at mid-heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 15, III/yiyou: five-colored clouds at mid-heaven.

sentences.zh: 七月戊戌、庚戌皆如之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on wuxu and gengxu, all the same.
translations.idiomatic: VII/wuxu and gengxu: all the same.

sentences.zh: 十六年三月甲辰，五色雲見日傍。

translations.literal: In the 16th year, third month, on jiachen, five-colored clouds appeared beside the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 16, III/jiachen: five-colored clouds beside the sun.

sentences.zh: 七月癸未、十七年二月戊辰皆如之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on guiwei, and in the 17th year, second month, on wuchen, all the same.
translations.idiomatic: VII/guiwei; Kangxi 17, II/wuchen: all the same.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，青氣一道，寬五尺餘。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinsi, one green vapor, over five chi wide.
translations.idiomatic: VI/xinsi: one green vapor over five chi wide.

sentences.zh: 壬午，蒼白氣一道，青氣三道，寬尺餘。

translations.literal: On renwu, one grayish-white vapor and three green vapors, each over one chi wide.
translations.idiomatic: renwu: one grayish-white vapor and three green vapors, each over one chi wide.

sentences.zh: 癸未，青氣一道，寬六尺餘，俱自西北至東南。

translations.literal: On guiwei, one green vapor, over six chi wide; all ran from northwest to southeast.
translations.idiomatic: guiwei: one green vapor over six chi wide; all northwest to southeast.

sentences.zh: 十八年八月乙丑，正北黃黑雲一道，變赤黃色，寬四尺餘，長數丈。

translations.literal: In the 18th year, eighth month, on yichou, one yellow-black cloud due north, shifting to red-yellow, over four chi wide and several zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 18, VIII/yichou: yellow-black cloud due north, turning red-yellow, over four chi wide and several zhang long.

sentences.zh: 十九年十一月戊午至辛酉，西南蒼白氣一道，寬尺餘，銳指東北，長三丈餘，漸長至四丈餘。

translations.literal: In the 19th year, eleventh month, from wuwu to xinyou, one grayish-white vapor in the southwest, over one chi wide, sharply pointing northeast, over three zhang long, gradually lengthening to over four zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 19, XI/wuwu–xinyou: grayish-white vapor southwest, over one chi wide, sharp toward northeast, over three zhang long, growing to over four zhang.

sentences.zh: 二十年六月辛卯，東北青氣六道。

translations.literal: In the 20th year, sixth month, on xinmao, six green vapors in the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 20, VI/xinmao: six green vapors in the northeast.

sentences.zh: 十月癸未，正北黑雲一道，穿北斗，約長三丈餘。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on guiwei, one black cloud due north, piercing the Northern Dipper, roughly three zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: X/guiwei: black cloud due north through the Northern Dipper, about three zhang long.

sentences.zh: 二十四年十月丙午，日上蒼白雲英出五色鮮明。

translations.literal: In the 24th year, tenth month, on bingwu, above the sun grayish-white cloud-radiance emitted five colors, bright and vivid.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 24, X/bingwu: grayish-white cloud-radiance above the sun shone in five vivid colors.

sentences.zh: 三十五年五月戊辰，五色雲見中天。

translations.literal: In the 35th year, fifth month, on wuchen, five-colored clouds appeared at mid-heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 35, V/wuchen: five-colored clouds at mid-heaven.

sentences.zh: 四十一年二月甲寅酉時，西南白雲一道，長二丈餘，寬尺餘，穿天倉、天苑，入地平，至丁巳，長三丈餘。

translations.literal: In the 41st year, second month, on jiayin, at the you hour, one white cloud in the southwest, over two zhang long and over one chi wide, passing through Celestial Granary and Heavenly Park and reaching the horizon; by dingsi it was over three zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 41, II/jiayin, you hour: white cloud southwest, over two zhang long and one chi wide, through Celestial Granary and Heavenly Park to the horizon; by dingsi over three zhang long.

sentences.zh: 六十一年十一月癸卯，五色雲見日上。

translations.literal: In the 61st year, eleventh month, on guimao, five-colored clouds appeared above the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 61, XI/guimao: five-colored clouds above the sun.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年九月丁丑朔，五色雲見中天。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Yongzheng, ninth month, on dingchou, the first day of the month, five-colored clouds appeared at mid-heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzheng 1, IX/dingchou (new moon): five-colored clouds at mid-heaven.

sentences.zh: 十月辛未、二年正月辛巳皆如之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on xinwei, and in the 2nd year, first month, on xinsi, all the same.
translations.idiomatic: X/xinwei; Yongzheng 2, I/xinsi: all the same.

sentences.zh: 五年八月辛亥丑時，正北黑雲一道，東西俱至地平，寬尺餘。

translations.literal: In the 5th year, eighth month, on xinhai, at the chou hour, one black cloud due north, both east and west reaching the horizon, over one chi wide.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzheng 5, VIII/xinhai, chou hour: black cloud due north, east and west to the horizon, over one chi wide.

sentences.zh: 七年三月戊辰，五色雲見日旁。

translations.literal: In the 7th year, third month, on wuchen, five-colored clouds appeared beside the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzheng 7, III/wuchen: five-colored clouds beside the sun.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，慶雲見於曲阜，環捧日輪，曆午、未、申三時，於時上發帑金修建闕里文廟。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingshen, auspicious clouds appeared at Qufu, encircling and embracing the solar disk, lasting through the wu, wei, and shen hours; at the time the throne disbursed treasury funds to rebuild the Confucian Temple at Que-li.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzheng 7, XI/bingshen: auspicious clouds at Qufu encircling the sun through wu, wei, and shen hours; the throne then disbursed treasury funds to rebuild the Confucian Temple at Que-li.

sentences.zh: 八年正月辛巳，五色雲見日下。

translations.literal: In the 8th year, first month, on xinsi, five-colored clouds appeared below the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzheng 8, I/xinsi: five-colored clouds below the sun.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑子時，正北至東南，黑雲一道，寬尺餘。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinchou, at the zi hour, from due north to southeast, one black cloud over one chi wide.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzheng 8, VI/xinchou, zi hour: due north to southeast, black cloud over one chi wide.

sentences.zh: 九年九月乙酉丑時，西北至東西，白雲二道，寬尺餘。

translations.literal: In the 9th year, ninth month, on yiyou, at the chou hour, from northwest to east-west, two white clouds, each a little over one chi wide.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzheng 9, IX/yiyou, chou hour: northwest to east-west, two white clouds each over one chi wide.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月，雲南奏報，年前十月二十九日，大理等府五色雲見；

translations.literal: In the first month of the 13th year, Yunnan memorialized that on the twenty-ninth day of the tenth month of the previous year, five-colored clouds had appeared in Dali and other prefectures;
translations.idiomatic: Yongzheng 13, I: Yunnan reported that on the 29th of the previous year's tenth month, five-colored clouds appeared in Dali and other prefectures;

sentences.zh: 廣東高州府如之。

translations.literal: Gaozhou Prefecture in Guangdong was the same.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozhou Prefecture in Guangdong reported the same.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年十月壬戌未時，五色雲見日上及旁。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Qianlong, tenth month, on renxu, at the wei hour, five-colored clouds appeared on the sun and beside it.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 1, X/renxu, wei hour: five-colored clouds on and beside the sun.

sentences.zh: 癸亥未時，乙丑辰、巳二時皆如之。

translations.literal: On guihai at the wei hour, and on yichou at the chen and si hours, all were the same.
translations.idiomatic: guihai, wei hour; yichou, chen and si hours: the same.

sentences.zh: 二年正月辛卯子時，西南至東北，黑雲一道，寬一尺。

translations.literal: In the 2nd year, first month, on xinmao, at the zi hour, from southwest to northeast, one black cloud one chi wide.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 2, I/xinmao, zi hour: southwest to northeast, one black cloud one chi wide.

sentences.zh: 三年七月己巳卯時，西北白雲一道，寬三寸，長一丈餘，往西南行。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year, seventh month, on jisi, at the mao hour, one white cloud in the northwest, three cun wide and a little over one zhang long, moving southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 3, VII/jisi, mao hour: one white cloud in the northwest, three cun by over one zhang, moving southwest.

sentences.zh: 四年三月乙丑寅時，東南雲一道，寬尺餘，長數丈。

translations.literal: In the 4th year, third month, on yichou, at the yin hour, one cloud in the southeast, a little over one chi wide and several zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 4, III/yichou, yin hour: one cloud in the southeast, over one chi wide and several zhang long.

sentences.zh: 丙寅巳時，北方白雲一道，寬七八寸，長三丈餘。

translations.literal: On bingyin at the si hour, one white cloud in the north, seven or eight cun wide and a little over three zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: bingyin, si hour: one white cloud in the north, seven or eight cun by over three zhang.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，北方白雲一道，寬尺餘，自東至西。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yiwei, one white cloud in the north, a little over one chi wide, from east to west.
translations.idiomatic: VIII/yiwei: one white cloud in the north, over one chi wide, east to west.

sentences.zh: 五年三月丁巳亥時，東南白雲一道，寬尺餘，長三丈餘。

translations.literal: In the 5th year, third month, on dingsi, at the hai hour, one white cloud in the southeast, a little over one chi wide and a little over three zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 5, III/dingsi, hai hour: one white cloud in the southeast, over one chi by over three zhang.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉亥時，東南黑雲一道，寬尺餘，長二丈餘。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on xinyou, at the hai hour, one black cloud in the southeast, a little over one chi wide and a little over two zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: V/xinyou, hai hour: one black cloud in the southeast, over one chi by over two zhang.

sentences.zh: 七年正月戊寅子時，月下白雲一道，寬尺餘，長三丈餘。

translations.literal: In the 7th year, first month, on wuyin, at the zi hour, one white cloud below the moon, a little over one chi wide and a little over three zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 7, I/wuyin, zi hour: one white cloud below the moon, over one chi by over three zhang.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉午時，五色雲繞日。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingyou, at the wu hour, five-colored clouds encircled the sun.
translations.idiomatic: II/dingyou, wu hour: five-colored clouds around the sun.

sentences.zh: 戊申巳時，見日旁；

translations.literal: On wushen at the si hour, they appeared beside the sun;
translations.idiomatic: wushen, si hour: beside the sun;

sentences.zh: 亥時，北方白雲一道，寬二尺餘，自東至西。

translations.literal: at the hai hour, one white cloud in the north, a little over two chi wide, from east to west.
translations.idiomatic: hai hour: one white cloud in the north, over two chi wide, east to west.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉子時，東方白雲一道，寬尺餘，長五尺。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiyou, at the zi hour, one white cloud in the east, a little over one chi wide and five chi long.
translations.idiomatic: VIII/jiyou, zi hour: one white cloud in the east, over one chi wide and five chi long.

sentences.zh: 甲寅巳時，五色雲捧日。

translations.literal: On jiayin at the si hour, five-colored clouds upheld the sun.
translations.idiomatic: jiayin, si hour: five-colored clouds flanking the sun.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子午時繞日。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiazi, at the wu hour, they encircled the sun.
translations.idiomatic: IX/jiazi, wu hour: around the sun.

sentences.zh: 十月庚寅辰時、丁酉辰時、八年三月丙辰辰時皆如之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on gengyin at the chen hour, on dingyou at the chen hour, and in the 8th year, third month, on bingchen at the chen hour—all were the same.
translations.idiomatic: X/gengyin and dingyou, chen hour; Qianlong 8, III/bingchen, chen hour: all the same.

sentences.zh: 己巳巳時見日上，丁丑酉時如之。

translations.literal: On jisi at the si hour they appeared on the sun; on dingchou at the you hour, the same.
translations.idiomatic: jisi, si hour: on the sun; dingchou, you hour: the same.

sentences.zh: 閏四月辛酉夜子時，月上白雲一道，寬尺餘，自西北至東南。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month, on xinyou, at the zi hour of the night, one white cloud above the moon, a little over one chi wide, from northwest to southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary IV/xinyou, zi hour: one white cloud above the moon, over one chi wide, northwest to southeast.

sentences.zh: 戊寅辰時，五色雲見日旁。

translations.literal: On wuyin at the chen hour, five-colored clouds appeared beside the sun.
translations.idiomatic: wuyin, chen hour: five-colored clouds beside the sun.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子酉時，見日上。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiazi, at the you hour, they appeared on the sun.
translations.idiomatic: VI/jiazi, you hour: on the sun.

sentences.zh: 戊辰未時，繞日。

translations.literal: On wuchen at the wei hour, they encircled the sun.
translations.idiomatic: wuchen, wei hour: around the sun.

sentences.zh: 甲戌巳、午二時如之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu at the si and wu hours, the same.
translations.idiomatic: jiaxu, si and wu hours: the same.

sentences.zh: 七月丁酉子時，繞月。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on dingyou, at the zi hour, they encircled the moon.
translations.idiomatic: VII/dingyou, zi hour: around the moon.

sentences.zh: 戊戌子時，北方白雲一道，寬尺餘，自東至西。

translations.literal: On wuxu at the zi hour, one white cloud in the north, a little over one chi wide, from east to west.
translations.idiomatic: wuxu, zi hour: one white cloud in the north, over one chi wide, east to west.

sentences.zh: 乙巳午、申二時，五色雲繞日。

translations.literal: On yisi at the wu and shen hours, five-colored clouds encircled the sun.
translations.idiomatic: yisi, wu and shen hours: five-colored clouds around the sun.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，見月上。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingmao, they appeared on the moon.
translations.idiomatic: VIII/dingmao: on the moon.

sentences.zh: 戊辰亥時，繞月。

translations.literal: On wuchen at the hai hour, they encircled the moon.
translations.idiomatic: wuchen, hai hour: around the moon.

sentences.zh: 十月丙辰巳時，見日下。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on bingchen, at the si hour, they appeared below the sun.
translations.idiomatic: X/bingchen, si hour: below the sun.

sentences.zh: 丁巳申時，繞日。

translations.literal: On dingsi at the shen hour, they encircled the sun.
translations.idiomatic: dingsi, shen hour: around the sun.

sentences.zh: 壬戌巳時，見日下。

translations.literal: On renxu at the si hour, they appeared below the sun.
translations.idiomatic: renxu, si hour: below the sun.

sentences.zh: 九年正月乙巳辰時至午時，見日上。

translations.literal: In the 9th year, first month, on yisi, from the chen hour to the wu hour, they appeared on the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 9, I/yisi, chen through wu hours: on the sun.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未戌時，繞月。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guiwei, at the xu hour, they encircled the moon.
translations.idiomatic: V/guiwei, xu hour: around the moon.

sentences.zh: 十一年七月乙巳亥時，中天白雲一道，長丈餘。

translations.literal: In the 11th year, seventh month, on yisi, at the hai hour, one white cloud at mid-heaven, a little over one zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 11, VII/yisi, hai hour: one white cloud at mid-heaven, over one zhang long.

sentences.zh: 十二年六月辛酉丑時，西南至正東，黑雲一道，寬三尺餘，俱至地平。

translations.literal: In the 12th year, sixth month, on xinyou, at the chou hour, from southwest to due east, one black cloud a little over three chi wide, all reaching the horizon.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 12, VI/xinyou, chou hour: southwest to due east, one black cloud over three chi wide, reaching the horizon.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，五色雲繞日。

translations.literal: On dinghai, five-colored clouds encircled the sun.
translations.idiomatic: dinghai: five-colored clouds around the sun.

sentences.zh: 十四年二月庚辰子時，東南黑雲一道，寬二尺餘，長十丈餘。

translations.literal: In the 14th year, second month, on gengchen, at the zi hour, one black cloud in the southeast, a little over two chi wide and a little over ten zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 14, II/gengchen, zi hour: one black cloud in the southeast, over two chi by over ten zhang.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申卯時，東方白雲一道，寬尺餘，長丈餘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wushen, at the mao hour, one white cloud in the east, a little over one chi wide and a little over one zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: XI/wushen, mao hour: one white cloud in the east, over one chi by over one zhang.

sentences.zh: 十八年二月丁亥朔申時，五色雲見日上。

translations.literal: In the 18th year, second month, on dinghai, the first day of the month, at the shen hour, five-colored clouds appeared on the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 18, II/dinghai (new moon), shen hour: five-colored clouds on the sun.

sentences.zh: 十九年四月丙申子時，中天白雲一道，自東南向西，寬尺餘，長二丈餘。

translations.literal: In the 19th year, fourth month, on bingshen, at the zi hour, one white cloud at mid-heaven, from southeast toward the west, a little over one chi wide and a little over two zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 19, IV/bingshen, zi hour: one white cloud at mid-heaven from southeast toward the west, over one chi by over two zhang.

sentences.zh: 二十一年五月辛巳亥時，東南白雲一道，寬尺餘，長數丈。

translations.literal: In the 21st year, fifth month, on xinsi, at the hai hour, one white cloud in the southeast, a little over one chi wide and several zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 21, V/xinsi, hai hour: one white cloud in the southeast, over one chi wide and several zhang long.

sentences.zh: 閏九月乙卯丑時，東北至西北如之。

translations.literal: In the intercalary ninth month, on yimao, at the chou hour, from northeast to northwest, the same.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary IX/yimao, chou hour: northeast to northwest, the same.
